faq: Will you change anything on my site?
No. An audit is read-only, so nothing on your site is touched. You get the report and decide what to act on, and we can quote the fixes separately if you want them done.
Your site link is enough for the Basic review. For deeper checks we ask for an administrator user, which you can remove afterward. We never need your passwords.
Is the audit useful if my site is small?

desc:
A WordPress site audit shows what is slowing, exposing or holding back your website, in a written report you can act on. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your WordPress site, ranks the findings and tells you what to fix first.

## What is a WordPress site audit and review?

A WordPress site audit is a structured check of your website's speed, security, plugins, theme, search setup, mobile layout, forms and links. It ends with a report. Each finding states what is wrong, why it matters and how it can be fixed.

An audit is not a rebuild. It tells you where your time and budget will do the most good, so you stop guessing.

## Why a review matters

Most WordPress sites change slowly over time. Plugins pile up, old pages stay online, updates get postponed and nobody checks the contact form after the last redesign. Each problem looks small, but together they cost visitors, leads and peace of mind.

The risk is also hidden. A broken form does not announce itself, and an outdated plugin looks fine until it causes trouble. A review brings these issues into the open while they are still cheap to fix.

## How an audit improves results

An audit works because it ranks problems. A site owner with a long to-do list tends to fix whatever is easiest. A ranked list puts the issue that costs you the most visitors or leads at the top, so effort goes where it counts.

Speed findings help visitors stay on the page. Search findings help the right people find you. Form and path findings help interested visitors reach you. Security and backup findings reduce the chance of losing the site itself. We cannot promise a specific outcome, because traffic, competition and your own content also play a part.

## What a thorough WordPress review covers

- Page speed on phone and desktop, with the biggest causes of delay named.
- The plugin list: what is outdated, unused, duplicated or heavy.
- Theme health, including whether a child theme protects your edits.
- Security settings, such as login protection, user roles and file permissions.
- Search basics: page titles, descriptions, headings and sitemap.
- Mobile layout on common screen sizes.
- Contact forms and the steps a visitor takes to reach you.
- Broken links and missing images.
- Backup routine and hosting setup.
- A plain-language summary at the top, followed by the detail.

## How we run the audit

We ask for a viewer or read-only style account where your setup allows it, and we examine the site from the outside as a visitor too. We do not change your site during an audit. Every issue is written down with a short explanation and a suggested fix.

The Basic package gives you a ranked health check in a PDF. Standard adds security and search review and a video call where we explain the top fixes. Premium goes further with forms, backup and hosting review, a fix roadmap and a re-check after you have made changes. Add-ons let us fix the first few issues for you or compare your site with a competitor.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us your main goal, such as more enquiries or fewer errors.
- Mention anything you already know is broken.
- Share your most important pages first.
- Use the call to ask about anything in the report.
- Fix the top items before the small ones.

**Avoid:**
- Treating every finding as equally urgent.
- Updating everything at once without a backup.
- Ignoring the report until problems appear.
- Installing a new plugin for every issue found.
- Sending your password instead of a user invitation.

## Who it is for

Owners who inherited a site from a previous developer often want a clear picture of what they have. Businesses planning a redesign can use an audit to see what to keep. Small sites that feel slow or odd, with no obvious cause, benefit as well, since the check is useful at any size.

## How to get started

Send your website address, your main goal and any worries you have. We invite ourselves as a limited user where possible and never ask for passwords. After the report arrives, you decide what to fix, either yourself, with your own developer or with us.
